lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, circular pixel clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial slits, with the highest-intensity centroids localized along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like matrix of high-intensity anchor nodes across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of commensal organisms (Echeneidae) is visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral-lateral margin and beneath the pectoral fin.
